_note: New actor, first pricing entry. Market (2026-10-25): Woolworths and Coles are separate actors elsewhere: dromb Coles 280 and Woolworths 276 monthly users, clearpath/coles-scraper 270 ($0.005 start), scrapesage/woolworths-scraper 263 at $0.002 per product, seemuapps 255 at $0.0012 per product + $0.005 per search. Nobody pairs the two stores. product $0.0015. Cost: direct/datacenter (no per-byte cost), Australian residential only as a fallback capped at 25% of charged revenue (~15 KB per product = $0.00012).

product.eventDescription: One Woolworths or Coles product with price, was-price, special, unit price, stock, barcode (Woolworths), category, image, URL and its match at the other store. Filtered-out rows are free.
